HeroSection.eyebrow: Full‑stack Software Engineer · Web · Cloud & DevOps
HeroSection.title: Building web products end to end
HeroSection.description: I’m Dai An — a full‑stack software engineer with 3+ years shipping production web apps in TypeScript, Next.js, and Nest.js. I own features from the interface through the API to the AWS infrastructure they run on, and I handle the DevOps side too: Terraform, Docker, and CI/CD.
HeroSection.marqueeText: Next.js • Nest.js • TypeScript • React • Vue.js • AWS • Terraform • Docker • GitHub Actions • PostgreSQL • MongoDB • Redis

AboutSection.title: About Me
AboutSection.description: I build web applications end‑to‑end — UI, APIs, and the cloud infrastructure they run on. Over 3+ years at Tokyo Tech Lab I’ve delivered client products ranging from an AI chatbot SaaS to live‑streaming and clinic booking platforms, and I own the DevOps side: Terraform infrastructure‑as‑code, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD. I work in English with overseas partners and enjoy turning ambiguous requirements into features that feel great to use.

softwareEngineer.description: Delivering features end-to-end across three concurrent client products in teams of 5–15 engineers, from technical design through code review to AWS release. Also the primary DevOps engineer on client work — Terraform infrastructure-as-code, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

softwareIntern.description: Built Gitman, an internal Git repository management tool, from scratch with Vue.js, TypeScript, Nest.js, and MongoDB, and shipped frontend features into the company's production HR platform. Promoted to full-time Software Engineer after six months.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Featured projects that show how I think, build, and ship products.

kotae.title: Kotae — AI Chatbot Platform
kotae.description: An AI chatbot SaaS for SME customer support: RAG-based knowledge Q&A built on OpenAI and LangChain, Next.js dashboards, an embeddable widget for third-party sites, and real-time messaging running on AWS.

starlive.title: StarLive — Live Streaming Platform
starlive.description: A paid live-streaming and 1:1 video-call platform with per-minute point billing, Tencent RTC integration, and a Nest.js worker monorepo on AWS SQS handling billing, notifications, and media processing.

ercBooking.title: ERC Booking — Clinic Scheduling
ercBooking.description: A clinic booking platform where I led DevOps: multi-environment AWS infrastructure provisioned with Terraform, GitHub Actions CI/CD with database migrations, plus RBAC APIs and an async email pipeline.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.description: This very site — a bilingual (EN/VI) Next.js portfolio, self-hosted on a VPS with Docker Compose and an Nginx HTTPS reverse proxy, auto-deployed by GitHub Actions and Watchtower with Telegram alerts.

hrm.title: HRM Platform — Human Resources
hrm.description: An internal HR system covering employee, timekeeping, and approval workflows for ~50 staff; I built the Vue 3 and TypeScript UI along with Nest.js APIs for core modules.

footer.about: Full‑stack software engineer building production web apps in TypeScript, Next.js, and Nest.js — with the AWS infrastructure and CI/CD behind them.
